plugins.name: grain
plugins.description: Ask a repository about its own conventions before writing code: where <intent> (where such things live, what is expected there, exemplars to copy), check <file> (how a file sits against the local norm), review (the same, for your whole change at once), completeness <file> (what historically co-changes with it), spectrum <file>, status/report/rules, export (the whole model as JSON for training pipelines), seed (a committed maintainer decision that steers a pattern) — plus an MCP server exposing the same read-only answers to any tool. Statistical answers mined from the repo's syntax trees and full git history; no model calls, no network, never blocks.
